Keeping your toes healthy is important for overall foot care. Wash your feet daily with mild soap and dry them well, especially between the toes, to prevent moisture buildup. Trim your nails straight across to avoid ingrown toenails. Wear comfortable, breathable shoes that fit properly to prevent pressure and irritation. Moisturize your feet but avoid applying lotion between the toes to reduce the risk of fungal infections. Check your toes regularly for any changes, discomfort, or signs of infection, and consult a professional if needed. #toe #relaxing #oddlysatisfying #satisfyingvideo  #healthytoe

👣 Been on your feet all day and they’re killing you? Don’t waste money on expensive shoes or massages. All you need is a tennis ball and 30 seconds. Your foot has over 100 muscles, and when they’re tight from being crammed in shoes all day, blood flow drops — and pain goes up. Here’s what to do 👇 ✅ Step on the tennis ball just below your big toe. ✅ Apply real pressure — don’t just lightly roll. ✅ Move slowly from the ball of your foot to your heel and back again. ✅ Find those tender spots and work them out. Just 30 seconds a day can relieve tension, improve blood flow, and reduce foot pain fast. #footpain #foothealth #painrelief
